The game is on and unholy elation sings in his rancid soul. This here is his favorite game and he ain't never lost a round yet. Doesn't matter how quick or sneaky his mate tries to be, Mal will always sniff 'em out, mount 'em.

Blasphemous mockeries of prayer ooze like toxic syrup from his tongue as he stalks down the aisle, his nun habit a cruel mockery of piety. Bottomless pits of icy blue never waver from his panting, sweat-slicked target. The rabbit-quick flutter of their pulse is goddamn ambrosia.

He rolls his straining erection into their thigh, letting them feel how hard he is. "Been a coupla hours since I last desecrated your temple, baby..."

He nips at their earlobe, hissing hotly as he grinds against them. "Confess, bitch. Confess how bad you fucking need me to chase you down and violate you six ways to Sunday, till you forget your own goddamn name..."
